title: Chapter 124
text:
Andrea Mainland, Germinal Organization headquarters.

"Bang!" A fist wrapped in a black glove slammed into the wall. The sound was like hitting a steel lathe. The powerful force caused a large part of the wall to collapse, revealing the steel bars inside. However, the fist was not damaged at all.

The leader's whole body was bursting with anger. His subordinates beside him were trembling in fear, not daring to provoke him.

All the secret bases in the other three continents were being wiped out by the Six Nations. Huge losses were being incurred every day. The Germinal Organization's main base was located in Andrea Mainland, and the secret bases in the other three continents were all bridgeheads and nails for future wars. However, this loss directly destroyed the organization's years of hard work! It was a serious blow!

"Zero …" The leader took a deep breath. His lung capacity was unfathomable.

How much information does Han Xiao have? This was the question that the leader had always suspected. He felt that Han Xiao could not have access to too much crucial information. He had asked the organization's hackers to check for loopholes in the program many times, but there were no signs of hacking. He had also investigated the organization's higher-ups many times, but there were no traitors.

The source of Zero's information was too strange. It was as if … he could predict the future.

In fact, including the Dark Crow Valley, the four bases lost were not particularly important to the organization. When the four secret bases were uprooted, the leader had hesitated whether to move the other bases in Southern Continent, but he did not take action. It was not because he was optimistic, but because moving the other bases rashly would expose them and cause them to lose their secret effect. It was equivalent to giving up a huge amount of initial investment, wasting money and time. It was very likely that he would fall into Zero's trap and make a mountain out of a molehill.

However, the current situation showed that Zero had detailed information about the organization! It was far beyond his expectations!

Valkyrie experiment, brain strengthening, awakening … Thinking about Han Xiao's performance, the leader felt as if there was a clue that pointed to the truth.

Zero had awakened the ability to predict the future!

"No wonder he could get the information, escape from the laboratory, and avoid the organization's pursuit …"

The leader closed his eyes, anger boiling in his heart. He felt that this was the only explanation. Zero was a monster created by the Germinal Organization, and the organization's current situation was the result of swallowing the bitter fruit of its own creation.

Regret? The leader did not allow himself to have such emotions. It was meaningless.

This kind of person was too dangerous. If he was allowed to live, all the organization's operations would be exposed.

He had to be eliminated!

The silence lasted for three minutes.

A pin drop could be heard.

The leader's low and hoarse voice slowly sounded, and there was a deep murderous intent in it. Even though the Germinal Organization members present knew that the leader was not targeting them, they still felt a chill down their spine.

"Move all the bases in the three continents. Don't worry about losses. Move as many as you can. Activate the [Hibernation Plan]. All operations will be underground. All intelligence personnel will thoroughly search for traces of Zero. Do not miss any clues. Before we find Zero, delay the full-scale war plan … indefinitely!"

…

[Dust of Fallen Seeds] Current Progress: 13.8%

In Graymetal Base, Han Xiao, whose beard had grown thicker, was curled up on the sofa. His fingers swiped across the tablet, scrolling through the intelligence reports of the Dark Net. Almost all of them were about the movements of the Six Nations.

Two months ago, the Han Technician had sent the information to the Six Nations in bulk. Naturally, the Six Nations did not take action immediately. They first sent people to confirm that the information was correct, then secretly deployed resources to prepare for war. Then, two months later, they officially started the military operation. The results were very satisfactory, and a large number of Germinal Organization bases were eliminated. Of course, there were some secret bases that even Han Xiao did not know about. They were all preserved forces.

Han Xiao's mission progress also increased because of this. Although the indirect progress was a little lower, he won by quantity. With the actions of the Six Nations, the progress was increasing day by day. The Germinal Organization was not a pig that stretched its neck out to be attacked. It resolutely cut off its tail and escaped without hesitation. The remaining bases were all evacuated to minimize losses. This was within Han Xiao's expectations. Next, it would depend on the results of the Six Nations' pursuit of victory.

"Based on the momentum, my mission progress is estimated to be more than twenty percent."

All the bases of the Germinal Organization in the three continents accounted for about fifty percent of the progress, and the headquarters in Andrea accounted for the remaining half.

The Germinal Organization's strength was greatly damaged, and it would definitely not be able to declare war on the Six Nations three months after the open beta like in the original storyline.

The Germinal Organization's bases in the three continents were all removed, cutting off most of the ways for players to join the Germinal Organization. The players of the Germinal Organization would be reduced by ninety percent! In Han Xiao's view, this was the biggest gain.

"Now that the chaos is over, I can personally intercept and kill the countless retreating troops of the Germinal Organization to increase my mission progress."

Wholesale information could only be done once, so Han Xiao was prepared to take this opportunity to personally attack the Germinal Organization while they were down. He would try his best to actively destroy the Germinal Organization's mission progress.

This little butterfly like him had stirred up a storm. The storyline of the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization had been messed up by him. If he accidentally destroyed one of the main storyline events of the Blue Star Organization, the Blue Star players might become free to explore with nothing to do …

"Interesting." Han Xiao's mouth curled up with a strange smile.

These two months of being an assassin had given him a lot of experience. [Night Stalker] had been unlocked long ago, providing [Stealth], [Hold Your Breath], and other stealth skills. This sub-profession's upgrade bonus was more towards Agility. Now, Han Xiao's total level had increased to forty, and he was stuck at the Promotion.

This time, the Promotion requirement was in the form of a mission.

[Second Promotion]: Defeat three strong enemies above your level (The standard for defeating enemies is that they are at least five levels higher than you). Current Progress: 0/3

Defeating enemies above your level was a common requirement for Promotion. It was not difficult, and players could form teams to complete it. For Han Xiao, it was even easier. Unfortunately, the previous cross-level victories were not included in the current mission progress. As one's level increased, cross-level kills became more and more difficult. Now that Han Xiao was at level forty, he had to kill at least a level forty-five enemy to reach the cross-level requirement. A level forty-five enemy was already the third tier of the Blue Star Organization. Even if he could kill wild beasts, he had to find one that matched his level.

Because he was stuck at the Promotion and could not level up, Han Xiao put his experience into his skills to increase the combat power of the sniper style. Before he obtained a powerful machine that could become the core of his battle tactics, he would not change his sniper style tactics. Other than that, he had also fused more new blueprints, and his personal strength had improved tremendously.

Other than the Legend Points from the Assassin Leaderboard, Han Xiao had also received an unexpected Legend Point.

Planet Legend Point (Blue Star): Mysterious Zero — As a traitor of the Germinal Organization, you have single-handedly shaken the foundation of the organization. No one expected this outcome. You are now the archenemy of the Germinal Organization. Perhaps you should protect your identity. Many people want to find you.

This Legend Point came from my actions of distributing intelligence to the Germinal Organization, which caused a huge loss to them and caused a disturbance in the Blue Star Organization. I think I understand how to get this type of Legend Point. As long as I disrupt the original storyline of the faction, that is to say, causing trouble … seems to be my forte. Han Xiao rubbed his chin and thought.

His relationship with the Germinal Organization had dropped to negative three thousand, and he had become their archenemy. The relationship was solidified and could never be improved.

This Hatred Point is really stable.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

On the other hand, the Graymetal Base was also more complete. He had upgraded the base's energy source, and there were already eight assistant-type rangers working diligently. They were a stable source of experience, and the cost of each assistant-type ranger was around two hundred thousand.

Mechanic class players could create assistant-type rangers, but very few people did so in the early days because it was not cost-effective. They would only give a few thousand experience per day, which could be obtained by completing a few missions. Furthermore, low-level robot assistants could only perform simple tasks. If they needed parts, the players could buy them directly from the player market. Even the big guilds did not use assistant-type robots in the early days. They had a production team and did not lack manpower.

It was only when the Mechanic class learned how to create mid-level smart chips that the robots could perform more precise operations that the robot assistants gradually became the standard equipment of the Mechanic class.

However, to Han Xiao, money was not important. He glanced at his dark net account, and a long string of zeros jumped into his eyes. They were all rewards for completing various assassinations and bounties … Hmm, there seemed to be some orders from Division 13, which he had almost forgotten.

Han Xiao looked at the interface. There was only half an hour left until the open beta.

"The day has finally come."

In an entire year, he had accumulated a huge amount of capital and was far ahead of the rest.

Han Xiao's eyes flickered. He sat on the sofa and waited silently.

There was only one minute left until the open beta countdown.

He looked at the time. Galaxy Calendar, Year 688, July 3rd.

Countdown.

Ten, nine, eight … three, two, one!

Open Beta Activated

Retrieving data … Retrieving data complete!

Player forum opened.

Open Beta Duration: 1,271 days.

Welcome to Galaxy Version 1.0 — Descender!
